items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Sandy Williams used to strike a match on the stand and turn around to Taft.

ctx.x: Yeah, Noble Sissle -- all of them were very light in that band. Alphonso Trent's band, most of them was light, most of them was real light. I think Snub Mosley was the darkest guy in the band.
Yes. Sandy Williams used to strike a match on the stand and turn around to Taft.
